name: CIMB Group Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年CIMB Group的公告主要为常规企业行动，包括季度业绩发布、股息派发、长期激励计划新股发行及董事会委员会成员变动。资料中未见有关业务板块扩张、新增业务、缩减或出售业务、或获得重大合约的公告。
overview_en: CIMB Group's 2026 announcements were mainly routine corporate actions, including quarterly results releases, dividend payments, new share issuances under the long-term incentive plan, and changes in board committee membership. The materials contain no announcements on business segment expansion, new businesses, downsizing or divestment, or major contract wins.
